# Firebase Hybrid Image Analyzer

> An Angular Progressive Web App (PWA) leveraging Firebase AI Logic and on-device WebGPU Gemini Nano for hybrid multimodal image analysis, smart cropping, visual calibration, and tag generation.

## Core Capabilities
- [Image Analysis & Tag Generation](/): Multimodal image classification, visual label extraction, and tag cloud generation.
- [Visual Calibration & Smart Crop](/): Aspect ratio presets (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 9:16) and contrast/brightness/saturation filters.
- [Web App Manifest](/manifest.webmanifest): Progressive Web App standalone configuration and icons.

## Platform Documentation
- [Firebase AI Logic](https://firebase.google.com/docs/ai-logic): Vertex AI for Firebase multimodal text and image generation.
- [Chrome Built-in AI (Prompt API)](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/built-in): Client-side WebGPU Gemini Nano hardware-accelerated local inference.
- [Angular Deferrable Views](https://angular.dev/guide/defer): Declarative `@defer` block lazy loading and hydration lifecycle.
- [Firebase App Check](https://firebase.google.com/docs/app-check): reCAPTCHA Enterprise and local debug token protection.
